description: Ring modulator built on a model of the four diode analogue circuit, with the diode response open to adjustment.

params.text: Sets the voltage the modelled diodes start conducting at, 0V to 10V; below it a diode puts out 0V.
Sets the voltage the modelled diodes reach a straight line response at, 0V to 10V; between that and the conduction voltage the response is bent.
Sets the strength of the diode response, 0.1 to 1 volts per volt.
Scales the CV for the control it serves, -100% to 100%; negative settings invert the CV.
Blends the signal input with the ring modulated result, 0 to 100% modulated.
Feeds the output back into the carrier, -100% to 100%; negative amounts return it inverted.
Scales the output back up, so that the diode settings no longer change the overall level.

inputs.text: The carrier, multiplied against the other input; feedback is added to this one.
The signal multiplied against the carrier, and the signal the blend fades back towards.
Adds to the diode conduction voltage, one volt per volt before the attenuverter.
Adds to the straight line voltage, one volt per volt before the attenuverter.
Adds to the strength of the diode response, 10V covering the full range before the attenuverter.
Adds to the blend, 10V covering the full range before the attenuverter.
Adds to the feedback amount, 10V covering the full range before the attenuverter.

outputs.text: The signal input and the ring modulated result blended by MIX.

notes: the graph draws the modelled diode response, so the effect of the three diode controls can be seen.
